brand.name: Felizbay
brand.slogan: Premium Drop Stitch Inflatable Swimming Pools
brand.description: Felizbay designs and supplies premium drop stitch inflatable swimming pools — rectangular and round models with rigid, rock-solid walls that set up in minutes and fold away for winter storage. Every pool is 100% pressure-tested before shipping and complies with EN 16582-1 and ASTM F2666 pool safety standards.
